unique_capabilities: Self-hosted MIT — unica do par com data sovereignty completa
API Channels — extensibilidade open para canais custom
BYOC WhatsApp WABA — conecta sua propria conta Meta direto, sem markup
Source code aberto — modificacao + custom UI ilimitados

plans.name: Hacker (Free)
key_features: Live chat, private notes, labels, canned responses
plans.limits: Up to 2 agents; 500 conversations/mo; 30-day data retention; Captain AI NOT included

plans.name: Startups
key_features: Email, FB, Instagram, TikTok, WhatsApp, SMS, Telegram, Line
Custom views/filters, transcripts, contact management, campaigns
plans.limits: Unlimited agents; conversations subject to fair use; 1-year retention

plans.name: Self-hosted (Community)
key_features: Captain AI NAO incluida (precisa Cloud para Captain)
plans.limits: Voce hospeda Docker/Heroku; estimado $20-50/mo VPS; sem suporte oficial

free_tier.limits: Hacker tem retention curto (30 dias) + sem Captain

ai_pricing.definition_credit: 1 credit ~ 1 AI action (resposta, suggestion, summarization). Documentacao oficial nao detalha custo por tipo de acao.
ai_pricing.captain_in_self_hosted: Self-hosted Community NAO tem Captain — Captain e exclusivo Cloud

pricing.annual_billing: Todos os Cloud plans cobram annually para preco listado

marketplace.app_count: 0 (nao tem marketplace formal; integracoes via webhooks/API)

integrations.in_app_sdk: Widget chat only (sem messenger SDK profundo como Intercom)

g2_complaints: User Experience nao tao polido quanto Intercom

ai_capabilities.model: NAO disclosed (vendor nao publica se usa OpenAI, Anthropic, ou modelo proprio)
ai_capabilities.rag_pipeline: Captain le help center, chats anteriores, FAQs como RAG sources — pipeline detalhado nao publicado
capabilities: AI Assistant: auto-resposta first-line baseada em help center + FAQs
Smart FAQs: surface knowledge gaps from common questions
Query: Ask Co-Pilot natural language search of customer history
ai_capabilities.languages_supported: 8 demonstradas marketing (English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Japanese, Chinese, Arabic) + Malayalam — Portuguese explicito

ai_capabilities.escalation_logic: Basico — hands off to human when needed (sem detalhes de regras)
ai_capabilities.credits_system: 300/500/800 credits/mo por tier; $20/1.000 extras; 1 credit ~ 1 AI action; documentacao detalhada falta
ai_capabilities.playground: Captain tem playground para test custom instructions; falta simulation mode robusto contra past customer questions
ai_capabilities.self_hosted_availability: Captain NAO disponivel em self-hosted Community — somente Cloud
weaknesses_per_third_party: Sem simulation mode para forecasting deflection antes de go-live

top_complaints: UI not as polished as Intercom

scalability.limits: Cloud subject to fair use; self-hosted unlimited (depends on infra)
scalability.data_residency: Cloud: hosted in their cloud (region nao detalhada); self-hosted: total controle
scalability.sla: Custom enterprise; nao publicado tier abaixo
compliance: Self-hosted permite atender LGPD/HIPAA/PCI dependendo da infra

differentiators_vs_intercom: Self-hosted MIT — data sovereignty + zero license cost
BYOC WhatsApp — conecta WABA propria sem markup
Source code modificavel — custom UI/integrations sem limite
Pricing tier mais barato 50-65% para mesmo headcount
weaknesses_vs_intercom: Captain AI sem modelo publicado nem deflection rate (Fin tem ambos)
Captain sem autonomous workflows nem custom actions
Captain NAO disponivel em self-hosted (so Cloud) — quebra a promessa OSS-only
In-app Messenger SDK menos polido que Intercom
Sem HIPAA out-of-box, sem multibrand (no Cloud)
Sem simulation mode para forecasting deflection
Sem pre-built case studies enterprise grandes (Intercom tem Lightspeed etc)

data_quality.ai_metrics: PARTIAL — Captain deflection NAO publicado, G2 reviewers e third-parties indicam Captain mais basico que Fin
